system_prompt_style.note: Coder composes instructions from capabilities (RepoContext files, Planning live reminder); inferred from README, code not opened.

env_context_strategy.note: Default Coder injects repo structure via RepoContext and exposes FileSystem read/search tools plus shell (rg, grep, find).

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Model-agnostic strategies: tool-result clearing, sliding-window trimming, LLM summarization, tiered; all window-relative, with live usage reporting
context_compaction.note: Default Coder: ClearToolResults(max_fraction=0.7) + ToolOutputLimits (tool_output_pruning). Sliding window, summarizing, and provider-native compaction are opt-in capabilities.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Drive a real Chromium page yourself: navigate, click, type, read, and inspect what the page did
observation_format.note: Default Coder tools return text. Screenshots are only inferred from the opt-in Playwright capability; the output format is not confirmed.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: The model writes one Python script that calls many tools inside a [Monty](https://github.com/pydantic/monty) sandbox
tool_call_format.note: Default is Pydantic AI provider tool calling (inferred). Code Mode is opt-in.

tool_count.note: Coder bundles FileSystem, Shell, RepoContext, Planning and SubAgents toolsets, but the evidence does not give tool counts.

edit_primitive.note: FileSystem is described only as 'read/write/edit/search'; the edit primitive is not shown.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Connect any MCP server's tools; local by default, provider-native connectors opt-in

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: serves it to editors like Zed over the [Agent Client Protocol](https://agentclientprotocol.com)
protocol_standardization.note: MCP comes from the core capability; other = ACP (experimental).

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The model orchestrates sub-agents from one Python script: fan-out, chain, vote in a single tool call
loop_primitives.note: Default is the typed Pydantic AI agent loop (react). Dynamic Workflow voting is opt-in.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Flag tool calls that need human approval before they run

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Model-owned task plans with a cache-safe live reminder

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Save, restore, resume (`continue_run`), and fork (`fork_run`) runs; file/SQLite/Mongo backends
